title: Restaurants and cafés
summary: Zaitoon, Himalaya Food Court, Campus Café, CCD, Cool Biz, Usha Café.

posts.md:
Looking for a proper meal, coffee, or a quick snack? Here are some of the most popular food spots on campus.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Zaitoon**

A popular restaurant serving a variety of North Indian, South Indian, Chinese, and fast-food options.

https://maps.app.goo.gl/szA4ZgkvPaCvxGj57
**Himalaya Food Court (HFC)**

One of the busiest food courts on campus with multiple food options.

https://maps.app.goo.gl/cmnPtE9nGN3xMqY69
**Campus Café (CC)**

A convenient place to grab snacks, beverages, and light meals.

https://maps.app.goo.gl/TmrCZSV98rxSESVL7
**Cafe Coffee Day (CCD)**

Perfect for coffee, beverages, and casual meetups.

https://maps.app.goo.gl/3Dt7mi2ywp1qiojd6
**Cool Biz**

Known for:

- Fresh Fruit Juices

- Milkshakes

- Falooda

https://maps.app.goo.gl/41Q5SkhrvTPtia5EA
**Usha Café**

A small café serving:

- Tea

- Coffee

- Snacks

Seating is limited and it gets crowded during peak hours.

https://maps.app.goo.gl/PAdzrwMoj8vTwm6aA

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Senior's Advice**

HFC and Zaitoon are great options if you're looking for a proper meal.

CCD and Usha Café are popular places to hang out with friends.
